inputs.commit_message: chore: verify canonical local clone after docs update
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail; ROOT=/home/hesham/gova; git -C "$ROOT" fetch --quiet origin main; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root='/home/hesham/gova'
def git(*args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(['git','-C',root,*args],text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip()
remote=git('rev-parse','origin/main').stdout.strip()
print(f'canonicalHead={head}')
print(f'originMain={remote}')
raw=git('diff','--name-only','-z').stdout
paths=[p for p in raw.split('\0') if p]
print(f'dirtyTrackedBefore={len(paths)}')
cleaned=[]; preserved=[]
for p in paths:
    fp=Path(root)/p
    if not fp.is_file():
        preserved.append(p); continue
    local_hash=git('hash-object','--',p).stdout.strip()
    rem=git('rev-parse',f'origin/main:{p}',check=False)
    remote_hash=rem.stdout.strip() if rem.returncode==0 else ''
    if local_hash and local_hash==remote_hash:
        git('restore','--source=HEAD','--staged','--worktree','--',p)
        cleaned.append(p)
    else:
        preserved.append(p)
print(f'cleanedMatchingOrigin={len(cleaned)}')
for p in cleaned: print('cleaned='+p)
for p in preserved: print('preservedDifferent='+p)
status=git('status','--porcelain').stdout
if not status.strip() and head!=remote:
    git('merge','--ff-only','origin/main')
    print('canonicalFastForward=yes')
else:
    print('canonicalFastForward=no')
    if status.strip():
        print('remainingLocalChanges=yes')
print('canonicalHeadAfter='+git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip())
PY
